# PacketDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPacketDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPacketDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPacketDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasPacketDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A bit-accurate map of a protocol data unit

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasPacketDiagram](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPacketDiagram.md)
- [UltraCanvasPacketDiagramProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasPacketDiagramProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPacketDiagram> CreatePacketDiagram( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPacketDiagram(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
